MLC Election 2026 ki 8 siton (shikshak va snatak) ke natijon ke bad kangres parti ke bhitar bagavat aur tikhe aatmamanthan ke svar mukhar ho gae hain. kangres ke lokasbha sansad manoj kumar ne ABP nyuz se khas batchit men bihar pradesh kangres kamiti (BPCC) ke shirsh netritv aur chunav prabandhan par behad ganbhir saval khare kie hain.
